name: atlas
description: A Pulumi package for managing Atlas authentication-platform resources (OAuth clients, SSO connections, resource servers, JWT templates, webhooks, roles, organizations, custom domains and more) as code.
attribution: This Pulumi package is based on the [`atlas` Terraform Provider](https://github.com/Atlas-Authorization/terraform-provider-atlas).

provider.description:
The provider type for the atlas package. By default, resources use package-wide configuration
settings, however an explicit `Provider` instance may be created and passed during resource
construction to achieve fine-grained programmatic control over provider settings. See the
[documentation](https://www.pulumi.com/docs/reference/programming-model/#providers) for more information.

active.description: Whether the plan is offered. Defaults to true.

amount.description: A free-form display string for the price, stored verbatim by Atlas — not parsed or converted. Use whatever units you display (e.g. `12.00` for $12, or `1200` for cents); Atlas does not interpret it. Pair it with `currency` and `interval`.

audience.description: Who may subscribe: `user` or `org`. Defaults to `user`.

currency.description: ISO currency code (e.g. `usd`). Defaults to `usd`.

features.description: Feature keys this plan grants, surfaced as the `fea` session claim.

free.description: True when the plan has no `stripePriceId` (the free tier).

interval.description: Billing interval: `month` or `year`. Defaults to `month`.

limits.description: Numeric caps this plan grants, keyed by limit name (e.g. `{ maxDevices = 5, maxSeats = 25 }`). Where `features` answer "can they?", limits answer "how many?"; they are surfaced on the verified token and merged under any per-organization override. Unset keeps the plan's current limits (none for a new plan); set to `{}` to clear them.

name.description: Human-readable plan name.

pricingModel.description: `flat`, `perSeat` or `metered`. Defaults to `flat`.

slug.description: URL-safe, instance-unique plan key — surfaced as the `pla` session claim.

stripeMeterId.description: Stripe meter id, for a `metered` plan.

stripePriceId.description: The recurring Stripe price a subscriber is charged. Omit for the free tier.

trialDays.description: Free trial length in days (0–3650), or omitted for none.

usageUnit.description: Usage unit label, for a `metered` plan.
